eventTemplate.title: [Camunda Infrastructure] ElasticIlmStopped
eventTemplate.description:
Elasticsearch ILM (Index Lifecycle Management) has been STOPPED for more than 1 day in namespace {dims} — can lead to reaching the maximum shard count or the cluster running out of disk space.

Caveats: (1) uses the underscored Prometheus spelling — same collector-scrape reasoning as elastic-high-shards.json. (2) drops the source rule's exclusion of ES 7.x clusters (a cross-metric join with elasticsearch_clusterinfo_version_info), same simplification datadog_alerts/ made. (3) a 1-day `for:` window means 1440 one-minute samples — verify your tenant doesn't cap the practical sample count; a scheduled Workflow evaluating a DQL query is the more common way Dynatrace users handle day-scale conditions.
